event_name: Date 25 November 2018 Time 19:09 2018 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 November The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 14 left the track in turns 8 & 9 gaining an advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 14 cut the chicane, leaving the track and gaining a lasting advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
